title: View first with explicit private-value fallback
hypothesis: For a keyed memory with 16/64 held-out values containing off-basis components, a shared rank-eight View with a preregistered residual-L2 gate 0.05 and explicit full-value fallback will keep held-out value RMSE <=0.02, fallback fraction <=0.25 and bank bytes <=0.75x explicit storage. Shared-only and int8 controls quantify when private state is needed.
physical_object: one shared 64x8 value basis fit from 192 aligned training values and a fixed key/radius table
mirror_coordinate: rank-eight coefficients for representable values; residual-gated private full value for off-basis values
logical_multiplicity: 256 addressed values; 192 train the shared basis and 64 heldout contain 16 seeded off-basis/private values
controls: shared PCA/View codes with no fallback
native PCA + same ordinary residual gate/private fallback

task.type: fixed-key external edit memory with aligned and off-basis counterfactual values

development.selection_metric: heldout RMSE, locality false-trigger, wrong-route, private fallback fraction and actual complete payload bytes

storage.deterministic_fallback_rule: Residual norm and 0.05 gate are stored in schema; no residual is free unless omitted by the gate; every allocated private vector is charged.

compute.query_proxy: All methods compare the same 256 keys of dimension 32. Shared decode charges 64*8 MACs; private fallback reads 64 values; every route comparison and key distance is counted.

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: adaptive heldout RMSE <=0.02, wrong-route <=0.005, locality false-trigger <=0.005, fallback fraction <=0.25, actual bank <=0.75x explicit and <=0.95x int8; replay succeeds. Exact native PCA+residual implementation means no Mirror-specific attribution.
gates.FAIL: Explicit upper valid but adaptive quality/bytes/fallback gates fail, int8 is a better quality-bytes point, or native PCA+residual exactly aliases the proposed View/fallback bank.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Explicit upper invalid, route validity >0.01, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Retrieval keys/radii are fixed across methods and fully paid.
The 16 private heldout residuals are constructed outside the training basis; this is a synthetic private-state frontier, not natural edit data.
The residual threshold is frozen at 0.05 before development; no fresh adaptation is allowed.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless all frozen gates pass and native fallback control does not alias the method.
